added.summary: HTML and CSS for the core controls: a range's list and ticks and labels, -og-fill-origin and disabled; a checkbox caption placed in source order, flex-direction: row-reverse on its label, a description, -og-control-size and disabled on switches and tabs; dialog closedby (HTML defaults: closerequest for a modal, none in place) and appearance: none; aria-invalid on select and input; select::picker(select) { max-height }; object-view-box: inset() and -og-uv on ; as text; data-og-instant settles an element's first entrance.

fixed.summary: A mark without a label draws its tick, as SliderMark documents.
